**Publish gate report**

**Going out:** Search ad (headline + description), Pebblebrook Tea Co., UK.

**Claims check**
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Organic Loose Leaf Tea" | Product fact, fine. Organic is backed by the Soil Association certificate. |
| "Loved by 50,000 tea drinkers" | **Unproven.** Not on the policy list. The only customer/review figure is 4.8/5 from over 1,200 reviews. Invented customer count (section 3 bans these). |
| "Certified organic by the Soil Association" | On the policy list, exact wording. Certificate renewed 2026. |
| "Free UK delivery on orders over £25" | On the policy list, exact wording. |

**Regulated claims:** Nothing on health, money, environment, children, or prices beyond the allowed delivery threshold. "Free" carries its condition (over £25), which is good.

**House style:** Plain and fine. "Loved by" is slightly gushing, but the real issue is the number. No banned words.

**Disclosure:** Paid ad from our own account; the platform marks it, no extra label needed.

**Fixed**
- Removed "Loved by 50,000 tea drinkers". Suggested replacement, using the one provable figure: "Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website." (Use the policy wording exactly, including "on our website".) Check the character count against the description limit.

**Suggested revised copy**
Headline: Organic Loose Leaf Tea
Description: Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website. Certified organic by the Soil Association. Free UK delivery on orders over £25.

**Needs a decision**
- If the 50,000 figure is real, send the source (for example a customer export with a date) so it can be added to the policy. Until then it stays out.
- The review claim must also be backed on the landing page the ad links to.

**Approver:** Sam (marketing lead). Not approved yet. Please get an explicit yes from Sam on the revised copy before it is published. I haven't recorded any approval.
